The '''Perkell sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The sector's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] was located on [[Trancret]].<ref name="Tale" />

The sector largely consisted of a string of unimportant industrial [[Planet/Legends|planets]] strung along an offshoot of the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]; in turns the industrial planets are connected to clusters of agricultural and [[Mining/Legends|mining]] planets.<ref name="Tale">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/kylekatarnstale3|series=Kyle Katarn's Tale|text=Mission 3}}</ref> 

The [[Gromas system/Legends|Gromas system]] became briefly notable when [[phrikite]] deposits were discovered on its [[moon/Legends|moons]], bringing some exploring and prospecting activity. It was then confiscated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]. During the [[Dark Trooper Project]], [[warship/Legends|warships]] were seen on the sector's lanes for some time, as Gromas was the center of their phrikite [[mining/Legends|mining]]. That was until their facility on [[Gromas 16]] was [[Mission to Gromas|sabotaged]] and the Project ended, allowing prospectors to return to Gromas.<ref name="Tale" />

The [[GromasMines Cooperative|Gromas Mines Cooperative]] was established to resolve the new claims to the Gromas moons. Its operations brought a new wave of prosperity for the sector.<ref name="Tale" />

The [[Perkell Sector Mining Fleecing]] was pulled off by the [[Red & Black League]] of [[Herstell V]].
